POUND.name: Pound
POUND.description: A physical attack delivered with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

KARATE_CHOP.name: Karate Chop
KARATE_CHOP.description: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

DOUBLE_SLAP.name: Double Slap
DOUBLE_SLAP.description: The foe is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times.

COMET_PUNCH.name: Comet Punch
COMET_PUNCH.description: The foe is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times.

MEGA_PUNCH.name: Mega Punch
MEGA_PUNCH.description: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

PAY_DAY.name: Pay Day
PAY_DAY.description: Numerous coins are hurled at the foe. Money is earned after battle.

FIRE_PUNCH.name: Fire Punch
FIRE_PUNCH.description: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the foe with a burn.

ICE_PUNCH.name: Ice Punch
ICE_PUNCH.description: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the foe frozen.

THUNDER_PUNCH.name: Thunder Punch
THUNDER_PUNCH.description: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

SCRATCH.name: Scratch
SCRATCH.description: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe.

VICE_GRIP.name: Vice Grip
VICE_GRIP.description: Huge, impressive pincers grip and squeeze the foe.

GUILLOTINE.name: Guillotine
GUILLOTINE.description: A vicious tearing attack with pincers. The foe will faint if it hits.

RAZOR_WIND.name: Razor Wind
RAZOR_WIND.description: Blades of wind hit the foe on the 2nd turn. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

SWORDS_DANCE.name: Swords Dance
SWORDS_DANCE.description: A frenetic dance of fighting. It sharply raises the ATTACK stat.

CUT.name: Cut
CUT.description: A basic attack. It can be used to cut down thin trees and grass.

GUST.name: Gust
GUST.description: Strikes the foe with a gust of wind whipped up by wings.

WING_ATTACK.name: Wing Attack
WING_ATTACK.description: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide.

WHIRLWIND.name: Whirlwind
WHIRLWIND.description: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.

FLY.name: Fly
FLY.description: A 2-turn move that hits on the 2nd turn. Use it to fly to any known town.

BIND.name: Bind
BIND.description: A long body or tentacles are used to bind the foe for two to five turns.

SLAM.name: Slam
SLAM.description: The foe is struck with a long tail, vines, etc.

VINE_WHIP.name: Vine Whip
VINE_WHIP.description: The foe is struck with slender, whip- like vines.

STOMP.name: Stomp
STOMP.description: The foe is stomped with a big foot. It may make the foe flinch.

DOUBLE_KICK.name: Double Kick
DOUBLE_KICK.description: Two legs are used to quickly kick the foe twice in one turn.

MEGA_KICK.name: Mega Kick
MEGA_KICK.description: The foe is attacked by a kick fired with muscle-packed power.

JUMP_KICK.name: Jump Kick
JUMP_KICK.description: The user jumps up high, then kicks. If it misses, the user hurts itself.

ROLLING_KICK.name: Rolling Kick
ROLLING_KICK.description: A quick kick from a rolling spin. It may make the foe flinch.

SAND_ATTACK.name: Sand-Attack
SAND_ATTACK.description: A lot of sand is hurled in the foe's face, reducing its accuracy.

HEADBUTT.name: Headbutt
HEADBUTT.description: The user sticks its head out and rams. It may make the foe flinch.

HORN_ATTACK.name: Horn Attack
HORN_ATTACK.description: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

FURY_ATTACK.name: Fury Attack
FURY_ATTACK.description: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times.

HORN_DRILL.name: Horn Drill
HORN_DRILL.description: The horn is rotated like a drill to ram. The foe will faint if it hits.

TACKLE.name: Tackle
TACKLE.description: A physical attack in which the user charges, full body, into the foe.

BODY_SLAM.name: Body Slam
BODY_SLAM.description: The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

WRAP.name: Wrap
WRAP.description: A long body or vines are used to wrap the foe for two to five turns.

TAKE_DOWN.name: Take Down
TAKE_DOWN.description: A reckless, full- body charge attack that also hurts the user a little.

THRASH.name: Thrash
THRASH.description: The user rampages about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.

DOUBLE_EDGE.name: Double-Edge
DOUBLE_EDGE.description: A reckless, life- risking tackle that also hurts the user a little.

TAIL_WHIP.name: Tail Whip
TAIL_WHIP.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe lower its DEFENSE stat.

POISON_STING.name: Poison Sting
POISON_STING.description: The foe is stabbed with a toxic barb, etc. It may poison the foe.

TWINEEDLE.name: Twineedle
TWINEEDLE.description: The foe is stabbed twice with foreleg stingers. It may poison the foe.

PIN_MISSILE.name: Pin Missile
PIN_MISSILE.description: Sharp pins are shot at the foe and hit two to five times at once.

LEER.name: Leer
LEER.description: The foe is given an intimidating look that lowers its DEFENSE stat.

BITE.name: Bite
BITE.description: The user bites with vicious fangs. It may make the foe flinch.

GROWL.name: Growl
GROWL.description: The user growls in a cute way, making the foe lower its ATTACK stat.

ROAR.name: Roar
ROAR.description: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.

SING.name: Sing
SING.description: A soothing song in a calming voice lulls the foe into a deep slumber.

SUPERSONIC.name: Supersonic
SUPERSONIC.description: The user generates odd sound waves. It may confuse the foe.

SONIC_BOOM.name: Sonic Boom
SONIC_BOOM.description: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 20- HP damage.

DISABLE.name: Disable
DISABLE.description: For a few turns, it prevents the foe from using the move it last used.

ACID.name: Acid
ACID.description: The foe is sprayed with a harsh, hide- melting acid that may lower DEFENSE.

EMBER.name: Ember
EMBER.description: The foe is attacked with small flames. The foe may suffer a burn.

FLAMETHROWER.name: Flamethrower
FLAMETHROWER.description: The foe is scorched with intense flames. The foe may suffer a burn.

MIST.name: Mist
MIST.description: The ally party is protected by a mist that prevents stat reductions.

WATER_GUN.name: Water Gun
WATER_GUN.description: The foe is struck with a lot of water expelled forcibly from the mouth.

HYDRO_PUMP.name: Hydro Pump
HYDRO_PUMP.description: A high volume of water is blasted at the foe under great pressure.

SURF.name: Surf
SURF.description: A big wave crashes down on the foe. Can also be used for crossing water.

ICE_BEAM.name: Ice Beam
ICE_BEAM.description: The foe is struck with an icy beam. It may freeze the foe solid.

BLIZZARD.name: Blizzard
BLIZZARD.description: The foe is blasted with a blizzard. It may freeze the foe solid.

PSYBEAM.name: Psybeam
PSYBEAM.description: A peculiar ray is shot at the foe. It may leave the foe confused.

BUBBLE_BEAM.name: Bubble Beam
BUBBLE_BEAM.description: A spray of bubbles strikes the foe. It may lower the foe's SPEED stat.

AURORA_BEAM.name: Aurora Beam
AURORA_BEAM.description: A rainbow-colored attack beam. It may lower the foe's ATTACK stat.

HYPER_BEAM.name: Hyper Beam
HYPER_BEAM.description: A severely damaging attack that makes the user rest on the next turn.

PECK.name: Peck
PECK.description: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

DRILL_PECK.name: Drill Peck
DRILL_PECK.description: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.

SUBMISSION.name: Submission
SUBMISSION.description: A reckless, full- body throw attack that also hurts the user a little.

LOW_KICK.name: Low Kick
LOW_KICK.description: A low, tripping kick that inflicts more damage on heavier foes.

COUNTER.name: Counter
COUNTER.description: A retaliation move that counters any physical hit with double the damage.

SEISMIC_TOSS.name: Seismic Toss
SEISMIC_TOSS.description: A gravity-fed throw that causes damage matching the user's level.

STRENGTH.name: Strength
STRENGTH.description: The foe is slugged at maximum power. Can also be used to move boulders.

ABSORB.name: Absorb
ABSORB.description: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

MEGA_DRAIN.name: Mega Drain
MEGA_DRAIN.description: A tough attack that drains half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

LEECH_SEED.name: Leech Seed
LEECH_SEED.description: A seed is planted on the foe to steal some HP for the user on every turn.

GROWTH.name: Growth
GROWTH.description: The user's body is forced to grow, raising the SP. ATK stat.

RAZOR_LEAF.name: Razor Leaf
RAZOR_LEAF.description: The foe is hit with a cutting leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

SOLAR_BEAM.name: Solar Beam
SOLAR_BEAM.description: A 2-turn move that blasts the foe with absorbed energy in the 2nd turn.

POISON_POWDER.name: Poison Powder
POISON_POWDER.description: A cloud of toxic dust is scattered. It may poison the foe.

STUN_SPORE.name: Stun Spore
STUN_SPORE.description: Paralyzing dust is scattered wildly. It may paralyze the foe.

SLEEP_POWDER.name: Sleep Powder
SLEEP_POWDER.description: A sleep-inducing dust is scattered in high volume around a foe.

PETAL_DANCE.name: Petal Dance
PETAL_DANCE.description: The user attacks with petals for two to three turns, then gets confused.

STRING_SHOT.name: String Shot
STRING_SHOT.description: The foe is bound with strings shot from the mouth to reduce its SPEED.

DRAGON_RAGE.name: Dragon Rage
DRAGON_RAGE.description: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 40- HP damage.

FIRE_SPIN.name: Fire Spin
FIRE_SPIN.description: The foe is trapped in an intense spiral of fire that rages two to five turns.

THUNDER_SHOCK.name: Thunder Shock
THUNDER_SHOCK.description: An electric shock attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

THUNDERBOLT.name: Thunderbolt
THUNDERBOLT.description: A strong electrical attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

THUNDER_WAVE.name: Thunder Wave
THUNDER_WAVE.description: A weak electric shock that is sure to cause paralysis if it hits.

THUNDER.name: Thunder
THUNDER.description: A brutal lightning attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

ROCK_THROW.name: Rock Throw
ROCK_THROW.description: The foe is attacked with a shower of small, easily thrown rocks.

EARTHQUAKE.name: Earthquake
EARTHQUAKE.description: An earthquake that strikes all POKéMON in battle excluding the user.

FISSURE.name: Fissure
FISSURE.description: The foe is dropped into a fissure. The foe faints if it hits.

DIG.name: Dig
DIG.description: An attack that hits on the 2nd turn. Can also be used to exit dungeons.

TOXIC.name: Toxic
TOXIC.description: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

CONFUSION.name: Confusion
CONFUSION.description: A weak telekinetic attack that may also leave the foe confused.

PSYCHIC.name: Psychic
PSYCHIC.description: A strong telekinetic attack. It may also lower the foe's SP. DEF stat.

HYPNOSIS.name: Hypnosis
HYPNOSIS.description: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.

MEDITATE.name: Meditate
MEDITATE.description: The user meditates to awaken its power and raise its ATTACK stat.

AGILITY.name: Agility
AGILITY.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to sharply boost its SPEED.

QUICK_ATTACK.name: Quick Attack
QUICK_ATTACK.description: An almost invisibly fast attack that is certain to strike first.

RAGE.name: Rage
RAGE.description: An attack that becomes stronger each time the user is hit in battle.

TELEPORT.name: Teleport
TELEPORT.description: Use it to flee from any wild POKéMON. Also warps to the last POKé CENTER.

NIGHT_SHADE.name: Night Shade
NIGHT_SHADE.description: An attack with a mirage that inflicts damage matching the user's level.

MIMIC.name: Mimic
MIMIC.description: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.

SCREECH.name: Screech
SCREECH.description: An ear-splitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe's DEFENSE.

DOUBLE_TEAM.name: Double Team
DOUBLE_TEAM.description: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

RECOVER.name: Recover
RECOVER.description: A self-healing move that restores HP by up to half of the user's maximum HP.

HARDEN.name: Harden
HARDEN.description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its DEFENSE stat.

MINIMIZE.name: Minimize
MINIMIZE.description: The user compresses all the cells in its body to raise its evasiveness.

SMOKESCREEN.name: Smokescreen
SMOKESCREEN.description: An obscuring cloud of smoke or ink reduces the foe's accuracy.

CONFUSE_RAY.name: Confuse Ray
CONFUSE_RAY.description: The foe is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

WITHDRAW.name: Withdraw
WITHDRAW.description: The user withdraws its body in its hard shell, raising its DEFENSE stat.

DEFENSE_CURL.name: Defense Curl
DEFENSE_CURL.description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its DEFENSE stat.

BARRIER.name: Barrier
BARRIER.description: The user creates a sturdy wall that sharply raises its DEFENSE stat.

LIGHT_SCREEN.name: Light Screen
LIGHT_SCREEN.description: A wall of light cuts damage from SP. ATK attacks for five turns.

HAZE.name: Haze
HAZE.description: Eliminates all stat changes among all POKéMON engaged in battle.

REFLECT.name: Reflect
REFLECT.description: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

FOCUS_ENERGY.name: Focus Energy
FOCUS_ENERGY.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses to raise its critical-hit ratio.

BIDE.name: Bide
BIDE.description: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back double.

METRONOME.name: Metronome
METRONOME.description: Waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into using any move at random.

MIRROR_MOVE.name: Mirror Move
MIRROR_MOVE.description: The user counters the move last used by the foe with the same move.

SELF_DESTRUCT.name: Self-Destruct
SELF_DESTRUCT.description: The user blows up to inflict severe damage, even making itself faint.

EGG_BOMB.name: Egg Bomb
EGG_BOMB.description: A large egg is hurled with great force at the foe to inflict damage.

LICK.name: Lick
LICK.description: The foe is licked and hit with a long tongue. It may also paralyze.

SMOG.name: Smog
SMOG.description: The foe is attacked with exhaust gases. It may also poison the foe.

SLUDGE.name: Sludge
SLUDGE.description: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.

BONE_CLUB.name: Bone Club
BONE_CLUB.description: The foe is clubbed with a bone held in hand. It may make the foe flinch.

FIRE_BLAST.name: Fire Blast
FIRE_BLAST.description: The foe is hit with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.

WATERFALL.name: Waterfall
WATERFALL.description: A powerful charge attack. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

CLAMP.name: Clamp
CLAMP.description: The foe is clamped and squeezed by the user's shell for two to five turns.

SWIFT.name: Swift
SWIFT.description: Star-shaped rays that never miss are fired at all foes in battle.

SKULL_BASH.name: Skull Bash
SKULL_BASH.description: The user raises its DEFENSE in the 1st turn, then attacks in the 2nd turn.

SPIKE_CANNON.name: Spike Cannon
SPIKE_CANNON.description: Sharp spikes are fired at the foe to strike two to five times.

CONSTRICT.name: Constrict
CONSTRICT.description: The foe is attacked with long tentacles or vines. It may lower SPEED.

AMNESIA.name: Amnesia
AMNESIA.description: Forgets about something and sharply raises SP. DEF.

KINESIS.name: Kinesis
KINESIS.description: The user distracts the foe by bending a spoon. It may lower accuracy.

SOFT_BOILED.name: Soft-Boiled
SOFT_BOILED.description: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.

HI_JUMP_KICK.name: Hi Jump Kick
HI_JUMP_KICK.description: A strong jumping knee kick. If it misses, the user is hurt.

GLARE.name: Glare
GLARE.description: The user intimidates the foe with the design on its belly to cause paralysis.

DREAM_EATER.name: Dream Eater
DREAM_EATER.description: Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.

POISON_GAS.name: Poison Gas
POISON_GAS.description: The foe is sprayed with a cloud of toxic gas that may poison the foe.

BARRAGE.name: Barrage
BARRAGE.description: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times.

LEECH_LIFE.name: Leech Life
LEECH_LIFE.description: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

LOVELY_KISS.name: Lovely Kiss
LOVELY_KISS.description: The user forces a kiss on the foe with a scary face that induces sleep.

SKY_ATTACK.name: Sky Attack
SKY_ATTACK.description: A 2nd-turn attack move with a high critical-hit ratio. The foe may flinch.

TRANSFORM.name: Transform
TRANSFORM.description: The user transforms into a copy of the foe with even the same move set.

BUBBLE.name: Bubble
BUBBLE.description: A spray of bubbles hits the foe. It may lower the foe's SPEED stat.

DIZZY_PUNCH.name: Dizzy Punch
DIZZY_PUNCH.description: The foe is hit with a rhythmic punch that may leave it confused.

SPORE.name: Spore
SPORE.description: The user scatters bursts of fine spores that induce sleep.

FLASH.name: Flash
FLASH.description: A blast of light that cuts the foe's accuracy. It also illuminates caves.

PSYWAVE.name: Psywave
PSYWAVE.description: The foe is attacked with an odd, hot energy wave that varies in intensity.

SPLASH.name: Splash
SPLASH.description: The user just flops and splashes around without having any effect.

ACID_ARMOR.name: Acid Armor
ACID_ARMOR.description: The user alters its cells to liquefy itself and sharply raise DEFENSE.

CRABHAMMER.name: Crabhammer
CRABHAMMER.description: A large pincer is used to hammer the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

EXPLOSION.name: Explosion
EXPLOSION.description: The user explodes to inflict terrible damage even while fainting itself.

FURY_SWIPES.name: Fury Swipes
FURY_SWIPES.description: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes two to five times.

BONEMERANG.name: Bonemerang
BONEMERANG.description: The user throws a bone that hits the foe once, then once again on return.

REST.name: Rest
REST.description: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.

ROCK_SLIDE.name: Rock Slide
ROCK_SLIDE.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe. It may make the foe flinch.

HYPER_FANG.name: Hyper Fang
HYPER_FANG.description: The foe is attacked with sharp fangs. It may make the foe flinch.

SHARPEN.name: Sharpen
SHARPEN.description: The user reduces its polygon count to sharpen edges and raise ATTACK.

CONVERSION.name: Conversion
CONVERSION.description: The user changes its type to match the type of one of its moves.

TRI_ATTACK.name: Tri Attack
TRI_ATTACK.description: A simultaneous 3-beam attack that may paralyze, burn, or freeze the foe.

SUPER_FANG.name: Super Fang
SUPER_FANG.description: The user attacks with sharp fangs and halves the foe's HP.

SLASH.name: Slash
SLASH.description: The foe is slashed with claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

SUBSTITUTE.name: Substitute
SUBSTITUTE.description: The user creates a decoy using one- quarter of its full HP.

STRUGGLE.name: Struggle
STRUGGLE.description: An attack that is used only if there is no PP. It also hurts the user.

SKETCH.name: Sketch
SKETCH.description: This move copies the move last used by the foe, then disappears.

TRIPLE_KICK.name: Triple Kick
TRIPLE_KICK.description: A 3-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.

THIEF.name: Thief
THIEF.description: An attack that may take the foe's held item if the user isn't holding one.

SPIDER_WEB.name: Spider Web
SPIDER_WEB.description: Ensnares the foe with sticky string so it doesn't flee or switch out.

MIND_READER.name: Mind Reader
MIND_READER.description: The user predicts the foe's action to ensure its next attack hits.

NIGHTMARE.name: Nightmare
NIGHTMARE.description: A sleeping foe is shown a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.

FLAME_WHEEL.name: Flame Wheel
FLAME_WHEEL.description: The user makes a fiery charge at the foe. It may cause a burn.

SNORE.name: Snore
SNORE.description: An attack that can be used only while asleep. It may cause flinching.

CURSE.name: Curse
CURSE.description: A move that works differently for the GHOST-type and all the other types.

FLAIL.name: Flail
FLAIL.description: A desperate attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

CONVERSION_2.name: Conversion 2
CONVERSION_2.description: The user changes type to make itself resistant to the last attack it took.

AEROBLAST.name: Aeroblast
AEROBLAST.description: A vortex of air is shot at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

COTTON_SPORE.name: Cotton Spore
COTTON_SPORE.description: Cotton-like spores cling to the foe, sharply reducing its SPEED stat.

REVERSAL.name: Reversal
REVERSAL.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

SPITE.name: Spite
SPITE.description: A move that cuts 2 to 5 PP from the move last used by the foe.

POWDER_SNOW.name: Powder Snow
POWDER_SNOW.description: Blasts the foe with a snowy gust. It may cause freezing.

PROTECT.name: Protect
PROTECT.description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.

MACH_PUNCH.name: Mach Punch
MACH_PUNCH.description: A punch thrown at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.

SCARY_FACE.name: Scary Face
SCARY_FACE.description: Frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its SPEED.

FAINT_ATTACK.name: Faint Attack
FAINT_ATTACK.description: The user draws up close to the foe disarmingly, then hits without fail.

SWEET_KISS.name: Sweet Kiss
SWEET_KISS.description: The user kisses the foe with sweet cuteness that causes confusion.

BELLY_DRUM.name: Belly Drum
BELLY_DRUM.description: The user maximizes its ATTACK stat at the cost of half its full HP.

SLUDGE_BOMB.name: Sludge Bomb
SLUDGE_BOMB.description: Filthy sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.

MUD_SLAP.name: Mud-Slap
MUD_SLAP.description: Mud is hurled in the foe's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

OCTAZOOKA.name: Octazooka
OCTAZOOKA.description: Ink is blasted in the foe's face or eyes to damage and lower accuracy.

SPIKES.name: Spikes
SPIKES.description: A trap of spikes is laid around the foe's party to hurt foes switching in.

ZAP_CANNON.name: Zap Cannon
ZAP_CANNON.description: An electric blast is fired like a cannon to inflict damage and paralyze.

FORESIGHT.name: Foresight
FORESIGHT.description: Completely negates the foe's efforts to heighten its ability to evade.

DESTINY_BOND.name: Destiny Bond
DESTINY_BOND.description: If the user faints, the foe delivering the final hit also faints.

PERISH_SONG.name: Perish Song
PERISH_SONG.description: Any battler that hears this faints in three turns unless it switches.

ICY_WIND.name: Icy Wind
ICY_WIND.description: A chilling wind is used to attack. It also lowers the SPEED stat.

DETECT.name: Detect
DETECT.description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.

BONE_RUSH.name: Bone Rush
BONE_RUSH.description: The user strikes the foe with a bone in hand two to five times.

LOCK_ON.name: Lock-On
LOCK_ON.description: The user locks on to the foe, making the next move sure to hit.

OUTRAGE.name: Outrage
OUTRAGE.description: The user thrashes about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.

SANDSTORM.name: Sandstorm
SANDSTORM.description: A 5-turn sandstorm that damages all types except ROCK, GROUND, and STEEL.

GIGA_DRAIN.name: Giga Drain
GIGA_DRAIN.description: A harsh attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

ENDURE.name: Endure
ENDURE.description: The user endures any hit with 1 HP left. It may fail if used in succession.

CHARM.name: Charm
CHARM.description: The foe is charmed by the user's cute appeals, sharply cutting its ATTACK.

ROLLOUT.name: Rollout
ROLLOUT.description: A 5-turn rolling attack that becomes stronger each time it hits.

FALSE_SWIPE.name: False Swipe
FALSE_SWIPE.description: A restrained attack that always leaves the foe with at least 1 HP.

SWAGGER.name: Swagger
SWAGGER.description: A move that makes the foe confused, but also sharply raises its ATTACK.

MILK_DRINK.name: Milk Drink
MILK_DRINK.description: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.

SPARK.name: Spark
SPARK.description: An electrically charged tackle that may also paralyze the foe.

FURY_CUTTER.name: Fury Cutter
FURY_CUTTER.description: An attack that grows stronger on each successive hit.

STEEL_WING.name: Steel Wing
STEEL_WING.description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user's DEFENSE.

MEAN_LOOK.name: Mean Look
MEAN_LOOK.description: The foe is fixed with a mean look that prevents it from escaping.

ATTRACT.name: Attract
ATTRACT.description: If it is the other gender, the foe is made infatuated and unlikely to attack.

SLEEP_TALK.name: Sleep Talk
SLEEP_TALK.description: While asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

HEAL_BELL.name: Heal Bell
HEAL_BELL.description: A soothing bell chimes to heal the status problems of all allies.

RETURN.name: Return
RETURN.description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its TRAINER.

PRESENT.name: Present
PRESENT.description: The foe is given a booby-trapped gift. It restores HP sometimes, however.

FRUSTRATION.name: Frustration
FRUSTRATION.description: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its TRAINER.

SAFEGUARD.name: Safeguard
SAFEGUARD.description: It protects the user's party from all status problems for five turns.

PAIN_SPLIT.name: Pain Split
PAIN_SPLIT.description: The user adds its HP to the foe's HP, then equally shares the total HP.

SACRED_FIRE.name: Sacred Fire
SACRED_FIRE.description: A mystical and powerful fire attack that may inflict a burn.

MAGNITUDE.name: Magnitude
MAGNITUDE.description: A ground-shaking attack against all standing POKéMON. Its power varies.

DYNAMIC_PUNCH.name: Dynamic Punch
DYNAMIC_PUNCH.description: The foe is punched with the user's full power. It confuses the foe if it hits.

MEGAHORN.name: Megahorn
MEGAHORN.description: A brutal ramming attack delivered with a tough and impressive horn.

DRAGON_BREATH.name: Dragon Breath
DRAGON_BREATH.description: The foe is hit with an incredible blast of breath that may also paralyze.

BATON_PASS.name: Baton Pass
BATON_PASS.description: The user switches out, passing along any stat changes to the new battler.

ENCORE.name: Encore
ENCORE.description: Makes the foe use the move it last used repeatedly for two to six turns.

PURSUIT.name: Pursuit
PURSUIT.description: An attack move that works especially well on a foe that is switching out.

RAPID_SPIN.name: Rapid Spin
RAPID_SPIN.description: An attack that frees the user from BIND, WRAP, LEECH SEED, and SPIKES.

SWEET_SCENT.name: Sweet Scent
SWEET_SCENT.description: Allures the foe to reduce evasiveness. It also attracts wild POKéMON.

IRON_TAIL.name: Iron Tail
IRON_TAIL.description: An attack with a steel-hard tail. It may lower the foe's DEFENSE stat.

METAL_CLAW.name: Metal Claw
METAL_CLAW.description: The foe is attacked with steel claws. It may also raise the user's ATTACK.

VITAL_THROW.name: Vital Throw
VITAL_THROW.description: Makes the user attack after the foe. In return, it will not miss.

MORNING_SUN.name: Morning Sun
MORNING_SUN.description: Restores the user's HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

SYNTHESIS.name: Synthesis
SYNTHESIS.description: Restores the user's HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

MOONLIGHT.name: Moonlight
MOONLIGHT.description: Restores the user's HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

HIDDEN_POWER.name: Hidden Power
HIDDEN_POWER.description: An attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the user.

CROSS_CHOP.name: Cross Chop
CROSS_CHOP.description: The foe is hit with double chops. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

TWISTER.name: Twister
TWISTER.description: A vicious twister attacks the foe. It may make the foe flinch.

RAIN_DANCE.name: Rain Dance
RAIN_DANCE.description: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up WATER- type moves.

SUNNY_DAY.name: Sunny Day
SUNNY_DAY.description: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up FIRE-type moves.

CRUNCH.name: Crunch
CRUNCH.description: The foe is crunched with sharp fangs. It may lower the foe's SP. DEF.

MIRROR_COAT.name: Mirror Coat
MIRROR_COAT.description: A retaliation move that pays back the foe's special attack double.

PSYCH_UP.name: Psych Up
PSYCH_UP.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

EXTREME_SPEED.name: Extreme Speed
EXTREME_SPEED.description: A blindingly speedy charge attack that always goes before any other.

ANCIENT_POWER.name: Ancient Power
ANCIENT_POWER.description: An ancient power is used to attack. It may also raise all the user's stats.

SHADOW_BALL.name: Shadow Ball
SHADOW_BALL.description: A shadowy blob is hurled at the foe. May also lower the foe's SP. DEF.

FUTURE_SIGHT.name: Future Sight
FUTURE_SIGHT.description: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked psychically.

ROCK_SMASH.name: Rock Smash
ROCK_SMASH.description: An attack that may also cut DEFENSE. It can also smash cracked boulders.

WHIRLPOOL.name: Whirlpool
WHIRLPOOL.description: The foe is trapped in a fast, vicious whirlpool for two to five turns.

BEAT_UP.name: Beat Up
BEAT_UP.description: All party POKéMON join in the attack. The more allies, the more damage.

FAKE_OUT.name: Fake Out
FAKE_OUT.description: An attack that hits first and causes flinching. Usable only on 1st turn.

UPROAR.name: Uproar
UPROAR.description: The user attacks in an uproar that prevents sleep for two to five turns.

STOCKPILE.name: Stockpile
STOCKPILE.description: The user charges up power for use later. It can be used three times.

SPIT_UP.name: Spit Up
SPIT_UP.description: The power built using STOCKPILE is released at once for attack.

SWALLOW.name: Swallow
SWALLOW.description: The energy it built using STOCKPILE is absorbed to restore HP.

HEAT_WAVE.name: Heat Wave
HEAT_WAVE.description: The user exhales a heated breath to attack. It may also inflict a burn.

HAIL.name: Hail
HAIL.description: A hailstorm lasting five turns damages all POKéMON except the ICE-type.

TORMENT.name: Torment
TORMENT.description: It enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move successively.

FLATTER.name: Flatter
FLATTER.description: Flattery is used to confuse the foe, but its SP. ATK also rises.

WILL_O_WISP.name: Will-O-Wisp
WILL_O_WISP.description: A sinister, bluish white flame is shot at the foe to inflict a burn.

MEMENTO.name: Memento
MEMENTO.description: The user faints, but sharply lowers the foe's ATTACK and SP. ATK.

FACADE.name: Facade
FACADE.description: An attack that is boosted if user is burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

FOCUS_PUNCH.name: Focus Punch
FOCUS_PUNCH.description: An attack that is executed last. The user flinches if hit beforehand.

SMELLING_SALT.name: Smelling Salt
SMELLING_SALT.description: Doubly effective on a paralyzed foe, but it also cures the foe's paralysis.

FOLLOW_ME.name: Follow Me
FOLLOW_ME.description: The user draws attention to itself, making foes attack only the user.

NATURE_POWER.name: Nature Power
NATURE_POWER.description: An attack that changes type depending on the user's location.

CHARGE.name: Charge
CHARGE.description: The user charges power to boost the ELECTRIC move it uses next.

TAUNT.name: Taunt
TAUNT.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves.

HELPING_HAND.name: Helping Hand
HELPING_HAND.description: A move that boosts the power of the ally's attack in a battle.

TRICK.name: Trick
TRICK.description: A move that tricks the foe into trading held items with the user.

ROLE_PLAY.name: Role Play
ROLE_PLAY.description: The user mimics the foe completely and copies the foe's ability.

WISH.name: Wish
WISH.description: A self-healing move that restores half the full HP on the next turn.

ASSIST.name: Assist
ASSIST.description: The user randomly picks and uses a move of an allied POKéMON.

INGRAIN.name: Ingrain
INGRAIN.description: The user lays roots that restore HP on every turn. It can't switch out.

SUPERPOWER.name: Superpower
SUPERPOWER.description: A powerful attack, but it also lowers the user's ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.

MAGIC_COAT.name: Magic Coat
MAGIC_COAT.description: Reflects back the foe's LEECH SEED and any status- damaging move.

RECYCLE.name: Recycle
RECYCLE.description: A move that recycles a used item for use once more.

REVENGE.name: Revenge
REVENGE.description: An attack move that gains in intensity if the target has hurt the user.

BRICK_BREAK.name: Brick Break
BRICK_BREAK.description: An attack that also breaks any barrier like LIGHT SCREEN and REFLECT.

YAWN.name: Yawn
YAWN.description: A huge yawn lulls the foe into falling asleep on the next turn.

KNOCK_OFF.name: Knock Off
KNOCK_OFF.description: Knocks down the foe's held item to prevent its use during the battle.

ENDEAVOR.name: Endeavor
ENDEAVOR.description: Gains power the fewer HP the user has compared with the foe.

ERUPTION.name: Eruption
ERUPTION.description: The higher the user's HP, the more powerful this attack becomes.

SKILL_SWAP.name: Skill Swap
SKILL_SWAP.description: The user employs its psychic power to swap abilities with the foe.

IMPRISON.name: Imprison
IMPRISON.description: Prevents foes from using any move that is also known by the user.

REFRESH.name: Refresh
REFRESH.description: A self-healing move that cures the user of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

GRUDGE.name: Grudge
GRUDGE.description: If the user faints, this move deletes the PP of the move that finished it.

SNATCH.name: Snatch
SNATCH.description: Steals the effects of the foe's healing or status- changing move.

SECRET_POWER.name: Secret Power
SECRET_POWER.description: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.

DIVE.name: Dive
DIVE.description: The user dives underwater on the first turn and strikes next turn.

ARM_THRUST.name: Arm Thrust
ARM_THRUST.description: A quick flurry of straight-arm punches that hit two to five times.

CAMOUFLAGE.name: Camouflage
CAMOUFLAGE.description: Alters the user's type depending on the location's terrain.

TAIL_GLOW.name: Tail Glow
TAIL_GLOW.description: The user flashes a light that sharply raises its SP. ATK stat.

LUSTER_PURGE.name: Luster Purge
LUSTER_PURGE.description: A burst of light injures the foe. It may also lower the foe's SP. DEF.

MIST_BALL.name: Mist Ball
MIST_BALL.description: A flurry of down hits the foe. It may also lower the foe's SP. ATK.

FEATHER_DANCE.name: Feather Dance
FEATHER_DANCE.description: The foe is covered with a mass of down that sharply cuts the ATTACK stat.

TEETER_DANCE.name: Teeter Dance
TEETER_DANCE.description: A wobbly dance that confuses all the POKéMON in battle.

BLAZE_KICK.name: Blaze Kick
BLAZE_KICK.description: A fiery kick with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also burn the foe.

MUD_SPORT.name: Mud Sport
MUD_SPORT.description: Weakens ELECTRIC- type attacks while the user is in the battle.

ICE_BALL.name: Ice Ball
ICE_BALL.description: A 5-turn rolling attack that becomes stronger each time it rolls.

NEEDLE_ARM.name: Needle Arm
NEEDLE_ARM.description: An attack using thorny arms. It may make the foe flinch.

SLACK_OFF.name: Slack Off
SLACK_OFF.description: The user slacks off and restores its HP by half its full HP.

HYPER_VOICE.name: Hyper Voice
HYPER_VOICE.description: The user lets loose a horribly loud shout with the power to damage.

POISON_FANG.name: Poison Fang
POISON_FANG.description: The foe is bitten with toxic fangs. It may also badly poison the foe.

CRUSH_CLAW.name: Crush Claw
CRUSH_CLAW.description: The foe is attacked with sharp claws. It may also lower the foe's DEFENSE.

BLAST_BURN.name: Blast Burn
BLAST_BURN.description: The foe is hit with a huge explosion. The user can't move on the next turn.

HYDRO_CANNON.name: Hydro Cannon
HYDRO_CANNON.description: The foe is hit with a watery cannon. The user can't move on the next turn.

METEOR_MASH.name: Meteor Mash
METEOR_MASH.description: The foe is hit with a hard, fast punch. It may also raise the user's ATTACK.

ASTONISH.name: Astonish
ASTONISH.description: An attack using a startling shout. It also may make the foe flinch.

WEATHER_BALL.name: Weather Ball
WEATHER_BALL.description: An attack that varies in power and type depending on the weather.

AROMATHERAPY.name: Aromatherapy
AROMATHERAPY.description: A soothing scent is released to heal all status problems in the user's party.

FAKE_TEARS.name: Fake Tears
FAKE_TEARS.description: The user feigns crying to sharply lower the foe's SP. DEF stat.

AIR_CUTTER.name: Air Cutter
AIR_CUTTER.description: The foe is hit with razor-like wind. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

OVERHEAT.name: Overheat
OVERHEAT.description: An intense attack that also sharply reduces the user's SP. ATK stat.

ODOR_SLEUTH.name: Odor Sleuth
ODOR_SLEUTH.description: Completely negates the foe's efforts to heighten its ability to evade.

ROCK_TOMB.name: Rock Tomb
ROCK_TOMB.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe's SPEED if it hits.

SILVER_WIND.name: Silver Wind
SILVER_WIND.description: The foe is attacked with a silver dust. It may raise all the user's stats.

METAL_SOUND.name: Metal Sound
METAL_SOUND.description: A horrible metallic screech is used to sharply lower the foe's SP. DEF.

GRASS_WHISTLE.name: Grass Whistle
GRASS_WHISTLE.description: A pleasant melody is played to lull the foe into a deep sleep.

TICKLE.name: Tickle
TICKLE.description: The foe is made to laugh, reducing its ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.

COSMIC_POWER.name: Cosmic Power
COSMIC_POWER.description: The user absorbs a mystic power to raise its DEFENSE and SP. DEF.

WATER_SPOUT.name: Water Spout
WATER_SPOUT.description: The higher the user's HP, the more powerful this attack becomes.

SIGNAL_BEAM.name: Signal Beam
SIGNAL_BEAM.description: The foe is hit with a flashing beam that may also cause confusion.

SHADOW_PUNCH.name: Shadow Punch
SHADOW_PUNCH.description: The user throws a punch from the shadows. It cannot be evaded.

EXTRASENSORY.name: Extrasensory
EXTRASENSORY.description: The user attacks with an odd power that may make the foe flinch.

SKY_UPPERCUT.name: Sky Uppercut
SKY_UPPERCUT.description: The user attacks with an uppercut thrown skywards with force.

SAND_TOMB.name: Sand Tomb
SAND_TOMB.description: The foe is trapped inside a painful sandstorm for two to five turns.

SHEER_COLD.name: Sheer Cold
SHEER_COLD.description: The foe is attacked with ultimate cold that causes fainting if it hits.

MUDDY_WATER.name: Muddy Water
MUDDY_WATER.description: The user attacks with muddy water. It may also lower the foe's accuracy.

BULLET_SEED.name: Bullet Seed
BULLET_SEED.description: The user shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot at once.

AERIAL_ACE.name: Aerial Ace
AERIAL_ACE.description: An extremely fast attack against one target. It can't be evaded.

ICICLE_SPEAR.name: Icicle Spear
ICICLE_SPEAR.description: Sharp icicles are fired at the foe. It strikes two to five times.

IRON_DEFENSE.name: Iron Defense
IRON_DEFENSE.description: The user hardens its body's surface to sharply raise its DEFENSE stat.

BLOCK.name: Block
BLOCK.description: The user blocks the foe's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

HOWL.name: Howl
HOWL.description: The user howls to raise its spirit and boost its ATTACK stat.

DRAGON_CLAW.name: Dragon Claw
DRAGON_CLAW.description: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.

FRENZY_PLANT.name: Frenzy Plant
FRENZY_PLANT.description: The foe is hit with an enormous branch. The user can't move on the next turn.

BULK_UP.name: Bulk Up
BULK_UP.description: The user bulks up its body to boost both its ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.

BOUNCE.name: Bounce
BOUNCE.description: The user bounces on the foe on the 2nd turn. It may paralyze the foe.

MUD_SHOT.name: Mud Shot
MUD_SHOT.description: The user attacks by hurling mud. It also reduces the foe's SPEED.

POISON_TAIL.name: Poison Tail
POISON_TAIL.description: An attack with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also poison the foe.

COVET.name: Covet
COVET.description: A cutely executed attack that also steals the foe's hold item.

VOLT_TACKLE.name: Volt Tackle
VOLT_TACKLE.description: The user throws an electrified tackle. It hurts the user a little.

MAGICAL_LEAF.name: Magical Leaf
MAGICAL_LEAF.description: The foe is attacked with a strange leaf that cannot be evaded.

WATER_SPORT.name: Water Sport
WATER_SPORT.description: Weakens FIRE-type attacks while the user is in the battle.

CALM_MIND.name: Calm Mind
CALM_MIND.description: The user focuses its mind to raise the SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats.

LEAF_BLADE.name: Leaf Blade
LEAF_BLADE.description: The foe is slashed with a sharp leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

DRAGON_DANCE.name: Dragon Dance
DRAGON_DANCE.description: A mystic, powerful dance that boosts the user's ATTACK and SPEED stats.

ROCK_BLAST.name: Rock Blast
ROCK_BLAST.description: The user hurls two to five hard rocks at the foe to attack.

SHOCK_WAVE.name: Shock Wave
SHOCK_WAVE.description: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes the foe. It can't be evaded.

WATER_PULSE.name: Water Pulse
WATER_PULSE.description: An attack with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

DOOM_DESIRE.name: Doom Desire
DOOM_DESIRE.description: A move that attacks the foe with a blast of light two turns after use.

PSYCHO_BOOST.name: Psycho Boost
PSYCHO_BOOST.description: An intense attack that also sharply reduces the user's SP. ATK stat.
